description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer IPC callback handling in the Rialto project. It tests the forwarding of playback state updates and handling of invalid handles.

classes.name: RialtoClientWebAudioPlayerIpcCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for WebAudioPlayer IPC callback tests, inheriting from WebAudioPlayerIpcTestBase.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates the WebAudioPlayer IPC instance.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment and destroys the WebAudioPlayer IPC instance.
